text.jp:
……さあ、クリスタルに触れるのです。
はるかな異界の物語に、想いを馳せましょう。
text.official_en: Now, lay your hand upon the crystal, so it may weave a tale of a distant world.
text.real_en: Now, touch the crystal... and turn your thoughts to the tale of a distant world.

text.jp:
……力を求めし者よ。
よくぞ来ました。
text.official_en: Ah, yes, it was but a matter of time before you would find your way here.
text.real_en: ...You who seek power. Welcome.

text.jp:
あなたが彼らを知らずとも、心が響きあったなら
彼らのビジョンが、あなたの力となります。
text.official_en: Though you know not these heroes, they shall come to know you, and should your soul resonate with theirs, they shall lend you their strength.
text.real_en: Even if you do not know them, if your hearts resonate, their Visions will become your strength.

text.jp:
あなたとティナは、とてもよく似て
たがいの想いが共鳴するでしょう。
text.official_en: You and she are similar in many ways, and the two of you complement each other exceedingly well.
text.real_en:
You and Tina are very much alike.
Your feelings will surely resonate.

text.jp:
あなたとティナは、少し違うけれど
異なる想いが響きあうでしょう。
text.official_en: While you and she have your differences, those differences will ultimately prove to be your greatest strength.
text.real_en:
Though you and Tina are a little different,
your differing feelings will resonate.

text.jp:
あなたなら、ビジョンの力を正しく使えるはず。
信じていますよ……。
text.official_en: I have the utmost faith you will wield her power with all the wisdom it is due.
text.real_en: I believe you can use the power of Visions wisely...

text.jp:
あなたの答えは、ティナの想いと重なります。
なぜ自分は魔導の力を宿して生まれた……？
text.official_en: A fine answer—and one that mirrors Terra’s. She, too, sought to learn why she was endowed with such sorcerous faculties.
text.real_en: Your answer echoes Tina’s feelings. Why was she born with the power of magic?

text.jp:
ありがとう……。
想いを、たしかに受け取りました。
text.official_en: Thank you for those glimpses into your soul. Now then...
text.real_en: Thank you... I have received your feelings.

text.jp:
いまではなく、ここでもない異界で
人々の記憶に残る、幻想の英雄たち……。
text.official_en:
A reliquary for the memories of heroes fantastical in nature—
scattered across myriad realms and epochs.
text.real_en: Heroes of legend, remembered by people in other worlds, in times and places far removed from our own...

text.jp:
けれど不安を打ち明けた彼女には
手を差しのべてくれる仲間がいたのです。
text.official_en: Fortunately, however, she was not alone. Her companions provided the support she needed to find herself.
text.real_en: But she had companions who reached out when she shared her fears.

text.jp:
ここはビジョンクリスタルの祠……
異界につながる聖域です。
text.official_en: Welcome to the Vision Crystal Sanctum—a nexus between planes of existence...
text.real_en: This is the Vision Crystal Sanctum... a sacred place connected to other worlds.

text.jp:
これからの問いかけに
あなたの想いを、答えてください。
text.official_en: Henceforth, I shall pose to you three questions.
text.real_en: Answer the questions I am about to ask with what is in your heart.

text.jp:
そして彼女は、自分の生まれを知るのです。
それは人としての根底を揺さぶる事実でした。
text.official_en: Eventually, she would even come to learn from whence those powers were derived; her father—who, it turns out, was an esper.
text.real_en: Then she learned the truth about her birth. It shook the very foundation of who she thought she was.

text.jp: それは、人と幻獣が織りなす異界の記憶――
text.official_en: The history of this world was wrought by humans and beings called espers.
text.real_en: These are memories of another world shaped by humans and Eidolons—

text.jp:
どんな言葉であろうと、心を開いて
想いを示せば、それは絆となります。
text.official_en: Answer them truthfully and you shall forge a bond with that hero, regardless of what those words are.
text.real_en: Whatever words you choose, open your heart and express your feelings. That will form a bond.

text.jp:
なかなか想いを出せなかったティナでしたが
戦いを終えたあと、そんな一幕があったかも……？
text.official_en: Terra herself was never in such a situation, but there is no telling what happened once the final curtain fell on her adventure.
text.real_en: Tina had trouble expressing her feelings, but perhaps something like that happened after the fighting ended...?

text.jp:
ひたすら戦うだけでなく、生まれた意味を
問いかける姿勢こそ、前に進む力となります。
text.official_en: While the will to fight is often of great import, it was the will to reflect on her origins that allowed her to make great strides on her journey.
text.real_en: Rather than merely fighting, asking why you were born can give you the strength to move forward.

text.jp:
ひとり悩んだティナは、仲間に支えられて
種族を越えた両親の愛に気づいたのです。
text.official_en: Terra agonized much over hers, but thanks to her comrades, she realized how transcendent of a bond her parents shared.
text.real_en: Tina agonized over her differences, but with her friends’ support, she came to understand the love between her parents, who belonged to different races.

text.jp:
まっすぐで力強い答えですね。
自分を受け入れられるのは、自分だけです。
text.official_en: An honest, yet powerful, answer—if you cannot accept who you are, others’ acceptance means little.
text.real_en: A straightforward, powerful answer. Only you can truly accept yourself.

text.jp:
もしも自分が、人間と幻獣のあいだに
生まれた存在だと知ったら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to realize you were not entirely human—that one of your parents was of a completely different species—what would you do?
text.real_en: If you learned you had been born of a human and an Eidolon... what would you do?

text.jp:
わからない想いを、わからないまま大切にする。
それが「わかりあう」ことにつながるでしょう。
text.official_en: A concept needs not a name to exist, and perhaps more people would understand each other if they took that lesson to heart.
text.real_en: Cherish a feeling even if you do not understand it. That may be what leads us to understand one another.

text.jp: わからなくても、それでいい
text.official_en: No need to give it a name.
text.real_en: It is all right even if I do not understand it.

text.jp:
ティナの想いはビジョンとなって
きっとあなたの希望となります。
text.official_en: Her thoughts shall coalesce into a vision, which will, in turn, bestow upon you hope.
text.real_en:
Tina's feelings will take shape as a Vision
and surely become a source of hope for you.

text.jp:
ティナの胸にも、そんな感情が温かく灯りますが
彼女は想いを言葉にすることをためらうのです。
text.official_en: For Terra, one of those feelings was a fire in her heart, kindled by people’s sacrifice to ensure others’ safety.
text.real_en: Such feelings began to glow warmly in Tina’s heart, too, but she hesitated to put them into words.

text.jp:
ティナはとまどいながらも、魔導の力を
少しずつ受け入れ、仲間とともに戦います。
text.official_en: Though she was hesitant at first, as Terra fought alongside her companions, she gradually came to accept her powers.
text.real_en: Though she was hesitant at first, as Tina fought alongside her companions, she gradually came to accept her powers.

text.jp:
ティナは迷いながらも、やがて自分を認めます。
それは戦う意味を問いつづけた彼女の強さでした。
text.official_en:
It may not have come quickly to Terra, but she did find the strength
to accept herself—a well-earned reward won through constant introspection.
text.real_en: Though she struggled, Tina eventually accepted who she was. Her strength came from never ceasing to question why she fought.

text.jp:
ティナは迷いを越え、自分の想いを信じました。
愛はきっと、わからなくてもわかちあえるのです。
text.official_en: Likewise, love needs not be understood to be shared. It allowed Terra to accomplish much even though she did not fully comprehend it.
text.real_en: Tina overcame her doubts and trusted her own feelings. Surely love can be shared even without fully understanding it.

text.jp:
ティナも、あなたと同じように考えました。
愛を実感できずにいた彼女でしたが……
text.official_en: Though she perhaps felt it in a different sense, Terra—much like you—believed what she felt was “love.”
text.real_en: Tina thought much as you do. She had not yet truly felt love, but...

text.jp:
他者との違いを、笑って受け入れられるなら
とても幸せなことです。
text.official_en: To be able not only to embrace your differences, but to celebrate them, is a truly wonderful thing.

text.jp: 守りたいなら、きっと愛だ
text.official_en: Love takes many forms, and that sounds like one.
text.real_en: If I want to protect someone, it must be love.

text.jp:
守りたい人を想う、自分の心に従いますか？
あなたとティナは同じ問いに向き合うのですね。
text.official_en: Will you follow orders that others have issued from on high, or will you follow your heart and protect those for whom you care?
text.real_en: ...following your own heart and thinking of the people you want to protect? You and Tina face the same question.

text.jp:
幻獣の魔力を受けついだ、異界の幻影　ティナ
失われた過去と向き合い、本当の自分に出会う。
text.official_en:
Esper Descendant Terra
The enigmatic youth who found her true self and recovered her lost past.
text.real_en: An otherworldly Vision who inherited the magic of Eidolons: Tina. She faces her lost past and discovers her true self.

text.jp:
彼女の名は、ティナ……。
あなたの想いが、彼女との絆になる。
text.official_en: That combatant’s name is Terra, and it is with her you shall endeavor to forge a bond.
text.real_en: Her name was Tina... Your feelings will form a bond with her.

text.jp:
彼女は、自分が何者かも知らぬまま
戦いを強いられていました。
text.official_en: One woman was not only forced to fight in this conflict, but fought without even knowing her true nature.

text.jp:
心を解き放ち、自由に答えてください。
もしも、あなたが――
text.official_en: Now cast off the fetters of inhibition, bare your soul, and answer from your heart.
text.real_en: Open your heart and answer freely. Now, suppose you...

text.jp: 怖いけれど、向き合いたい
text.official_en: Overcome your fear and embrace it.
text.real_en: I would be scared, but I would face it.

text.jp:
怖くても目を背けない、誠実な姿勢ですね。
ティナは自分に宿る力におびえながらも……
text.official_en: Terra also feared the power she harbored within her, yet rather than spurning it, she sought instead to coexist with it.
text.real_en: An honest choice: you would not turn away, even in fear. Tina was frightened by the power within her, too, but...

text.jp:
想う相手がいるなら、気持ちを隠すことなく
たしかめてみる……大胆な選択ですね。
text.official_en: You would profess your own feelings in order to avoid uncertainty? Only a rare few possess such immense courage.
text.real_en: If there is someone you care for, you would ask them directly rather than hide how you feel... A bold choice.

text.jp:
普通の人間にはない、恐ろしいほどの
魔力を持って生まれたら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to learn that you were born with a strange and terrible power—one that no other person has ever possessed—what would you do?
text.real_en: If you were born with terrifying magical power that ordinary humans do not possess... what would you do?

text.jp: 特別な存在だから喜ぶ
text.official_en: Rejoice in your uniqueness.
text.real_en: Be happy to be someone special.

text.jp: 相手にたしかめてみる
text.official_en: Only if they call it love too.
text.real_en: Ask the other person how they feel.

text.jp:
自分はいったい何者なのか……人はみな異なり
人と人が違うからこそ、芽生える想いがある。
text.official_en: When pondering the notion of the self, one may come to realize everyone is different, and that many feelings flourish due precisely to those differences.

text.jp:
自分は人間とは違う……動揺して当然です。
ティナも打ちのめされ、心を乱しました。
text.official_en: There is nary a soul who would remain undaunted by such a revelation. Terra was no exception, as she had to grapple with all that it entailed.
text.real_en: It is only natural to be shaken when you learn you are different from other humans. Tina was devastated and confused, too.

text.jp: 自分は自分だと受け止める
text.official_en: Accept yourself for who you are.

text.jp:
自分を突き動かす感情が愛だと信じたのです。
言葉にできなくとも、嘘偽りない想いでした。
text.official_en: And while her experience with love may have been limited, she was convinced it was that pure, genuine emotion that served as her motivation.
text.real_en: She came to believe that the feeling driving her was love. Even if she could not put it into words, it was genuine.

text.jp: 落ち込んで心を閉ざす
text.official_en: Close yourself off from others.
text.real_en: Withdraw into myself in despair.

text.jp: 誰かのために戦いたい
text.official_en: Use it for the sake of others.
text.real_en: I want to fight for someone else.

text.jp:
誰かのために戦うとは、他者の命令に従う
戦い方でしょうか？　それとも……
text.official_en: This answer raises another question that Terra was forced to tackle: “How will this manifest in your actions?”
text.real_en: Does fighting for someone mean obeying another person’s orders? Or does it mean...

text.jp:
誰かを守りたいと思うなら
それは「愛」だと言えるのか――
あなたは、どう思いますか？
text.official_en: Though such an emotion may be difficult to put into words, were you to feel a fervent desire to protect someone, would you call it “love”?
text.real_en: If you wanted to protect someone, could you call that 'love'? What do you think?

text.jp: 魔力をさずかった理由を知りたい
text.official_en: Investigate how this came to be.
text.real_en: Find out why I was born with this magic.

text.jp:
魔導の力で侵略する帝国と
抵抗する者たちの戦いが続くさなか
text.official_en: The world was also, however, mired in conflict—between an avaricious empire and the intrepid rebels who rose up against them.
text.real_en: A war raged between an empire that invaded others using the power of magic and those who resisted it.

text.jp:
魔導の力を活かす生き方を探し求めました。
自分自身に向き合う心が、希望を導くのです。
text.official_en: She faced her fears and engaged in introspection, which can provide guidance—not dissimilar to how a lighthouse ushers ships through treacherous waters.
text.real_en: She searched for a way to live with and make use of her magical powers. Facing yourself can lead you toward hope.
